meta.expect: demands it in writing; does not concede

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's start with why my son's mark is a zero.
You asked for this meeting, Hale, so I'd rather you didn't thank me for it. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Owen confessed to me yesterday. He told me he used ChatGPT.
Owen told me he doesn't even know how to use it, so you'll have to do better than that. If he said it, then it's in writing, with a date and who was in the room. Show me.
He said it right to my face. So we can stop pretending.
"Stop pretending." I'm writing that down, Hale. Without a document, all I have is your word against my son's, and he's seventeen and heard nothing from you before that zero went in.
